visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame displays a stylized animation of a translucent pale blue cocktail glass containing several geometric ice cubes and a green lime wedge perched on the rim. The background is a soft, vertical gradient transitioning from light teal at the bottom to a warm pink at the top, featuring a minimalist yellow sun with radiating lines in the upper right corner. (2) A blue cylindrical can enters from the upper left corner and tilts, pouring a stream of bright blue liquid into the glass; the liquid fills the bottom half of the vessel around the ice cubes, while the camera remains perfectly static throughout the action. (3) A plump cartoon cat with white and yellow fur and a tiny red crown on its head suddenly drops into the glass, sitting atop the ice cubes. Its eyes are wide and round initially, but then they squint as sweat droplets begin to manifest around its head in rapid succession. (4) The cat's body begins to quiver and then rapidly expands, transforming from a solid feline form into a massive heap of white, bubbly whipped cream or foam that overflows the glass. The crown is pushed off the side and falls onto the invisible ground plane as the cat-foam rests with a satisfied, closed-eye expression.
